items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: We had Pico was playing with us, Albert Francis, Pete Alexander, and myself.

ctx.x: That's right, he died in New York, somewhere up the line there. Yes. And I played with Kid Rainey lots of times. And we had a little band of our own. We had Pico was playing with us, Albert Francis, Pete Alexander, and myself. And we just had a little folk concert. And then I played for Frank Quintella when he had a place at Toulouse in Decatur. We played there for about two years. We had a little band, you know, playing around. And we played in a lot of little places. We even played at the ballet club, right in…
No, what's his name? Do you remember?
